Detached inventory records and asynchronous extraction are operation APIs, not implementations of live model blob/prog_id/show_as_icon properties.
PROG_ID icon_filename will denote original packaged inert artwork metadata, never an ambient host path; no copied icon assets are authorized.
Baseline audit headers describe historical collection; this focused receipt does not modify their unowned source files or claim current whole-API coverage.

securityMappings.bytes: Explicit BinaryInput admission; extraction yields an owned Uint8Array copy. No implicit host reads or recursive parsing.
securityMappings.external: External targets remain strings. No download, activation or fallback to host resolution.
securityMappings.model: Neutral snake_case model spellings remain reserved by the shared SDK contract. Operation camelCase records do not replace those obligations.
securityMappings.controls: Controls, web extensions, fonts and 3D are opaque preservation/extraction only; no interpreter, font installer, decoder or renderer.
